body:
Thank you all for attending the meeting today, even just parts of it! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10601):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Olli Pettay, Yoav Weiss, Peter Van der Beken (for the first part), Mu-An Chiou, Michael Smith, Simon Pieters, Kagami Rosylight, Anne van Kesteren (for the second part)  
Scribe: 

1. Review past action items
    1.  Chris will ping the thread on [allow notifications and actions to specify a navigable URL](https://github.com/whatwg/notifications/pull/213).
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. None.
1. New topics
    1. [Joey] [Content model and 'what' to render for stylable `<select>` elements](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10317)
        1. Carry over.
    1. [Yoav] [Add a noopener-allow-popups value to COOP](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10394)
        1. Carry over.
    1. [Joey] [Timing of cloning for the `<selectedoption>` element](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10520)
        1. Carry over.
    1. [Yoav] [Dynamic import maps](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10528)
        1. Olli will ping Yulia and Jonco

### Action Items

1.  @smaug---- will ping @codehag and @Jonco3 for [Dynamic import maps](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10528).

### Minutes

-  Only 3 people showed up in the first 10 minutes, and Yoav asked Olli to ask folks at Mozilla to take a look at the Dynamic import maps pr
-  Then after that Mike, muan, and Anne showed up. And later Mike left and Kagami and Simon joined.
    -  Anne and Mike briefly discussed various `<input type=number>` requirements.
    -  `<select>` would be good to discuss with Joey.
